units.rhetorical_move: promises a precise quantification

original_instantiations: one model quantifies both price and risk
the optimal management strategy follows from it

units.source_excerpt: This article presents a model to precisely quantify price and risk.
units.reusable_pattern: Open by naming the two things the model quantifies.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a third output.

units.rhetorical_move: decomposes the model innovatively
units.function: split the work and claim the split is new

original_instantiations: the model splits into two sub-problems
the split is called innovative

units.source_excerpt: We innovatively decomposed our model into two sub-problems.
units.reusable_pattern: Announce a decomposition and call it innovative.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the novelty word.

units.rhetorical_move: builds the price on three scopes

original_instantiations: the price model is built three times
the scopes run individual, community, nation

units.source_excerpt: We created the price model on individual scope, community scope and nation scope.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the scopes in the order they are built.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reorder the scopes.

units.rhetorical_move: launches a conclusion from one factor

original_instantiations: one age band is the most willing to share
the conclusion is launched from generational differences

units.source_excerpt: From generational differences we can launch a conclusion about who shares most.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep launch a conclusion as the writer's phrasing.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace launch with draw when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says willingness can hardly resurgence
units.function: keep the noun used as a verb

original_instantiations: a breach cuts willingness heavily
recovery can hardly resurgence soon

units.source_excerpt: Willingness can hardly resurgence in a short time after a breach.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep resurgence used as a verb.
reusable_elements: a noun used as a verb
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct it to resurge when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: bounds the inaccuracy
units.function: give the worst error, then the judgment

original_instantiations: the error stays within a stated bound
the model is therefore called highly practical

units.source_excerpt: The inaccuracy is no more than a stated bound, so the model is highly practical.
units.reusable_pattern: Follow an error bound with highly practical.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the bound.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model has well robustness
units.function: keep the adverb in place of the adjective

original_instantiations: error analysis and robustness analysis are both run
the outcome is called well robustness

units.source_excerpt: The outcome shows our model has well robustness.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep well robustness as the writer's phrasing.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct well to good when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: blueprints further development

original_instantiations: advantages and weaknesses are summarized
further development is blueprinted

units.source_excerpt: At last, we summarized our advantage and weakness, and blueprinted further development.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep blueprinted as the verb for future work.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace it with planned when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: thanks the client for working with us
units.function: open the letter on the relationship

original_instantiations: the salutation names the client by title
thanks come before any result

units.source_excerpt: Thank you for working with us to design a plan.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a client letter with thanks for working with us.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open the letter on a number.

units.rhetorical_move: splits a right into two natures

original_instantiations: value and risk fall into two natures
the natures are personality and economic rights

units.source_excerpt: Value and risk divide into two categories by their nature: personality and economic rights.
units.reusable_pattern: Split one right into two natures before giving advice.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not advise before the split.

units.rhetorical_move: grades information by sensitivity

original_instantiations: general information may be used more
the most sensitive kind must be strictly controlled

units.source_excerpt: General information can be used more, while the most sensitive must be strictly controlled.
units.reusable_pattern: Grade protection into three bands of sensitivity.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not flatten the bands.

units.rhetorical_move: warns that blind sharing brings risk
units.function: name the group and its blind spot

original_instantiations: one age group shares far more openly
less experience leaves them blind to the risk

units.source_excerpt: Because young people have less experience, their blind sharing may bring greater risks.
units.reusable_pattern: Pair an open attitude with the risk its holders cannot see.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not praise the openness alone.

units.rhetorical_move: says only a small share of leaks is internal

original_instantiations: internal leaks are the smaller share
their destructive force is obviously greater

units.source_excerpt: Only a small share of leakage comes from staff, but its destructive power is obviously greater.
units.reusable_pattern: Set a small share against a greater harm.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the small share as the small threat.

units.rhetorical_move: opens on two borrowed quotations

original_instantiations: two named speakers are quoted
both talk about the wish for privacy

units.source_excerpt: The section opens by quoting two named speakers on the wish for privacy.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a background with borrowed words before your own.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the quotations as your own.

units.rhetorical_move: treats privacy as a tradable commodity

original_instantiations: some want protection and others want sharing
the team treats privacy as a commodity that can be exchanged

units.source_excerpt: We view privacy as a commodity that can be quantified and traded.
units.reusable_pattern: State the stance after showing the disagreement.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hide that the stance is a choice.

units.rhetorical_move: says the team is certain to construct

original_instantiations: a policy model is promised
the team calls itself certain to construct it

units.source_excerpt: Our team is certain to construct a policy model.
units.reusable_pattern: Claim certainty with certain to rather than aim to.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not soften certain.

units.rhetorical_move: walks the three levels

original_instantiations: pricing models are set up at three levels
weights come from two methods combined

units.source_excerpt: We set up pricing models from three levels: individuals, groups and countries.
units.reusable_pattern: Preview the paper as three levels.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a level the paper lacks.

units.rhetorical_move: says each assumption is justified

original_instantiations: the assumptions exist to simplify
each one is justified and consistent with fact

units.source_excerpt: Each of our assumptions is justified and consistent with the basic fact.
units.reusable_pattern: Promise that every assumption carries its justification.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave an assumption bare.

units.rhetorical_move: says a leak joins the identity theft ring
units.function: state the assumption as a fate

original_instantiations: once information leaks it changes status
it becomes part of an identity theft ring

units.source_excerpt: Once the information is leaked, it becomes part of the identity theft ring.
units.reusable_pattern: State an assumption as what a thing becomes once an event happens.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hedge the fate.

units.rhetorical_move: calls data selection of great significance
units.function: justify the data before using it

original_instantiations: authenticity and extensiveness make the model practical
the data were found only after repeated search

units.source_excerpt: The selection of data is of great significance, and we found it after repeated search.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the data choice of great significance and mention the search.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the data as the first thing found.

units.rhetorical_move: says the sample cannot meet the need
units.function: reject a dataset, then replace it

original_instantiations: one published dataset is too small
part of the data is therefore simulated

units.source_excerpt: These data cannot meet the needs of our model, so part of the data is simulated.
units.reusable_pattern: Reject a dataset for its size, then say what replaces it.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hide the simulation.

units.rhetorical_move: says the three levels are progressive

original_instantiations: individuals, groups and countries form a progression
each level has its own parameters

units.source_excerpt: The three levels are a progressive relationship, each with its own parameters.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the levels progressive so the order matters.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the levels as interchangeable.

units.rhetorical_move: separates value from price

original_instantiations: the result at two levels is called value
value is a relative concept, not a price

units.source_excerpt: The result is value rather than price, and value is a relative concept.
units.reusable_pattern: Separate value from price before reporting either.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not use the two words interchangeably.

units.rhetorical_move: justifies a source as the most cited

original_instantiations: six characteristics are selected
the source article is called the most cited in its field

units.source_excerpt: We selected the characteristics according to the most cited article in that field.
units.reusable_pattern: Justify a source by calling it the most cited.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not cite without the claim.

units.rhetorical_move: says the method is well-known
units.function: introduce a method by its reputation

original_instantiations: one weighting method is called well-known
it is the most commonly used for scientific empowerment

units.source_excerpt: It is well-known that this process is the most commonly used method of scientific empowerment.
units.reusable_pattern: Introduce a method with it is well-known that.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the reputation as proof.

units.rhetorical_move: pairs a subjective method with an objective one

original_instantiations: one method is subjective and optional
the other is objective but ignores experience

units.source_excerpt: One method is subjective, the other can miss experience, so we combine them.
units.reusable_pattern: Combine two methods by naming the fault each one has.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim either method is faultless.

units.rhetorical_move: defines the best as nearest and farthest

original_instantiations: the best case sits nearest the positive ideal
it also sits farthest from the negative ideal

units.source_excerpt: The best evaluation is nearest the positive ideal and farthest from the negative ideal.
units.reusable_pattern: Define best by two distances, not one.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the negative ideal.

units.rhetorical_move: says the effect gradually strengthened

original_instantiations: two years are compared, one real and one simulated
sharing makes the network effect gradually strengthened

units.source_excerpt: With the sharing of data, the social network effect gradually strengthened.
units.reusable_pattern: Report a change as gradually strengthened.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not give the change a rate.

units.rhetorical_move: says the change stays consistent

original_instantiations: the driving factors barely change
so every area moves consistently over the stated span

units.source_excerpt: Risk perception in all areas has a relatively consistent change over the stated span.
units.reusable_pattern: Call a shared movement relatively consistent.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the areas are identical.

units.rhetorical_move: says neither side knows the other's quotation

original_instantiations: information between buyers and sellers is seriously asymmetric
neither knows the other's quotation, so the game is static

units.source_excerpt: Buyer and seller do not know the other's quotation, so the game is one of incomplete information.
units.reusable_pattern: Classify a game by what each side cannot see.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not call the game complete.

units.rhetorical_move: says a protected kind grows short of supply
units.function: trace a policy to a price

original_instantiations: special information is protected by regulation
it then grows short of supply and its price rises

units.source_excerpt: Protected information will be short of supply, so its price will rise.
units.reusable_pattern: Carry a protection rule through to a higher price.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not stop at the rule.

units.rhetorical_move: says the adjustment makes the model more scientific

original_instantiations: group risk perception is adjusted for culture
the model becomes more scientific and accurate

units.source_excerpt: Adjusting for this makes the model more scientific and accurate.
units.reusable_pattern: Close an adjustment with more scientific and accurate.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reduce it to one adjective.

units.rhetorical_move: says the fact cannot be ignored
units.function: refuse to leave a value out

original_instantiations: some value is not owned by its stakeholders
ignoring that fact is refused

units.source_excerpt: We cannot ignore the fact that part of the value is shared by other people.
units.reusable_pattern: Bring in a neglected value with we cannot ignore the fact.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave the value out anyway.

units.rhetorical_move: lists the risks one group faces

original_instantiations: one group is named
three distinct risks are then listed for it

units.source_excerpt: The risks one group faces include psychological harm, marginalization and broken relations.
units.reusable_pattern: List the risks that belong to one named group.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not give the list to a different group.

units.rhetorical_move: says the judgment cannot be simple

original_instantiations: one category covers dignity
another covers property, so a single label fails

units.source_excerpt: This cannot be judged as a human right simply, since it also belongs to property.
units.reusable_pattern: Refuse a single label with cannot be judged simply.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not pick one label anyway.

units.rhetorical_move: says the curves connect at one price point
units.function: read the crossing as the optimum

original_instantiations: buyer and seller curves meet at one point
that point is called the optimal price

units.source_excerpt: The two sides connect at one price point, and that point is the optimal price.
units.reusable_pattern: Read a crossing of two curves as the optimal price.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not report the crossing without calling it optimal.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model is credible

original_instantiations: the gap against real data stays inside a bound
the model is therefore called credible

units.source_excerpt: The model reflects the real situation, that is to say, the model is credible.
units.reusable_pattern: Restate a judgment with that is to say.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not skip the restatement.

units.rhetorical_move: doubles the article

original_instantiations: replacing a few features changes little
replacing the an increasing number changes a lot

units.source_excerpt: The results change greatly when the an increasing number of features are replaced.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the doubled article.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not delete the extra word when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says stability is strong

original_instantiations: results hold when few features change
the model is said to have strong stability

units.source_excerpt: The results hold after substitution, so the model has strong stability.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a substitution test with strong stability.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim stability against every change.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model draws on predecessors fully

original_instantiations: classic models and algorithms are used
the team draws on the wisdom of predecessors fully

units.source_excerpt: We draw on the wisdom of our predecessors fully.
units.reusable_pattern: Credit earlier work with draw on the wisdom fully.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the method is original.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model is creative

original_instantiations: the model is split by level and by kind
considering group risk makes it more creative

units.source_excerpt: Considering the group's risk makes our model more creative.
units.reusable_pattern: Derive creativity from one structural choice.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim creativity without the choice.

units.rhetorical_move: says simplification leaves errors

original_instantiations: reality is a complicated system
simplifying it leaves the model with some errors

units.source_excerpt: These simplifications leave the model with some errors.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit that simplifying leaves errors.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the errors were removed.

units.rhetorical_move: says some models are only inferences

original_instantiations: few ways exist to obtain the data
some models stay theoretical and need data to test

units.source_excerpt: Some models are only theoretical inferences and require data to test.
units.reusable_pattern: Mark untested parts as only theoretical.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present them as tested.

units.rhetorical_move: defers the dynamic game to the next step

original_instantiations: the current game is static
a dynamic game will be established in the next step

units.source_excerpt: We will establish a dynamic game model in the next step.
units.reusable_pattern: Promise an upgrade with in the next step.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the upgrade is done.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model addresses all eight tasks

original_instantiations: all the required tasks are addressed
the model is called innovative and practical

units.source_excerpt: Our model solves all the tasks required and is innovative and practical.
units.reusable_pattern: Close by saying all the tasks are solved.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not name a task left open.

units.rhetorical_move: repeats one year twice

original_instantiations: two time points are picked at random
the same year is printed for both

units.source_excerpt: We randomly picked two time points and printed the same year for both.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the year that is printed twice.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the second year when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: numbers sources in brackets

original_instantiations: each source opens with a bracketed number
several entries break off before the page range

units.source_excerpt: Sources open with a bracketed number, and some break off early.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the bracketed numbering.
prohibited_generalizations: The citation list belongs to this paper and does not transfer.

units.rhetorical_move: lists the scripts by number

original_instantiations: the scripts are numbered
each number names one file

units.source_excerpt: The appendix lists the scripts by number, one file each.
units.reusable_pattern: Point at the numbered script list instead of reprinting it.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reproduce the scripts in the body.
